description:
Requirements:

  • University degree in Business Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field;
  • Several years of relevant professional experience in the automotive industry;
  • Proven experience in Supplier Quality Management;
  • Knowledge of VDA 6.3 and IATF 16949 standards;
  • Good command of quality management tools and methodologies, including FMEA, APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, and 8D;
  • Knowledge of automotive sustainability requirements and applicable industry standards;
  • Fluency in English.

 

Personal Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills;
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented attitude;
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within a team;
  • High level of responsibility, adaptability, and resilience;
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Main responsibilities:

  • Performs supplier sustainability initiatives and identifies critical supplier;
  • Conducts quarterly supplier performance evaluations, monitors action plan implementation, and verifies supporting evidence;
  • Maintains and regularly updates supplier information in the JQ Supplier Portal, including certificates, contact details, and other required data based on supplier self-assessments;
  • Manages supplier evaluation and development activities;
  • Supports audits of existing and potential suppliers in accordance with VDA 6.3 and automotive industry requirements;
  • Prepares and participates in internal and external audits across all JQ EU/NA production sites;
  • Monitors supplier corrective action plans and verifies their effectiveness;
  • Supports supplier approval processes, including the negotiation and conclusion of quality agreements (GHV/RV/QSV) prior to supplier nomination;
  • Collaborates with Commodity Management (JQDE) on supplier identification, evaluation, and selection;
  • Implements and manages supplier escalation processes;
  • Supports production sites in supplier communication and follow-up in accordance with established escalation procedures;
  • Supports the global standardization of procurement processes, tools, documentation, and data management structures;
  • Supports global procurement sustainability initiatives, including the collection, analysis, and monitoring of supply chain carbon footprint data (CCF and PCF);
  • Coordinates EMRT and CMRT assessments with suppliers and evaluate related sustainability risks;
  • Monitors and supports compliance with FSC certification requirements.

About us 

JOYSONQUIN Automotive Systems Romania produces steering wheels and ornamental elements for the dashboard, doors and center console, based on a modern technology and the diversity of materials used: noble veneer, leather, carbon and plastic. For over 20 years we have been satisfying the needs of our clients, renowned car manufacturers, such as Mercedes, Bentley, Audi, BMW, Porsche and Volkswagen. The quality of the products and the trust that our customers give us are the result of the professionalism of our employees. The company has 1000 employees in Ghimbav, Romania and is constantly developing.
